morning.insight:
💡 「나쁜 소식이 좋은 소식」

9월 NFP 29K 쇼크는 Fed 금리인상 경로에 제동을 걸었습니다. 미국 증시는 이미 사상 최고를 경신하며 금리 동결을 선반영한 모양새. 다만 고용 둔화는 경기 둔화 신호이기도 해서, 4분기 증시의 방향성은 10월 FOMC(11/1 예정)에서 갈릴 전망입니다.

국내 증시는 삼전·하이닉스 자사주가 7,000선 방어에 성공했지만, 외국인 이탈과 개인 투매가 동시에 진행 중. 다음 주 삼성전자 잠정실적(10/8 전망)이 본격적인 방향성의 시험대가 될 것으로 보입니다.

코스닥이 장중 900선을 3개월 만에 터치한 점은 반가운 신호지만, 마감 893으로 밀린 점이 아쉽습니다.

articles.headline: 재정경제부, 시장상황점검회의…고유가·고금리 대응 논의
articles.eng: Finance ministry reviews market amid oil, rate stress
articles.body: 재정경제부가 관계기관 합동 시장상황점검회의를 열고 국내외 금융·외환시장 동향과 채권·주택시장 상황을 점검했다. 고유가·고금리 국면에 대한 대응 방향을 논의했다.

articles.headline: 청년미래적금 2차 가입 7일부터…연 최대 19.4%
articles.eng: Youth savings signup opens Oct 7 at up to 19.4%
articles.body: 2차 청년미래적금 가입 신청이 10월 7일부터 시작된다. 연 최대 19.4%의 금리 혜택을 제공해 청년층 자산형성을 지원하는 상품이다.

articles.headline: Stocks Rise as September Jobs Report Cools Fed Rate-Hike Bets
articles.body: Stocks rose after September payrolls grew by only 29,000, far below the 90,000 expected, cooling fears that a hot labor market would force another Fed rate hike. The S&P 500 and Dow closed at records.

articles.headline: Iran Pressed to Make Nuclear Concessions to Revive Peace Talks With U.S.
articles.body: Washington is pressing Iran to make nuclear concessions to revive peace talks, even as the U.S. boosts its military presence in the region and a blockade chokes off Iranian crude exports.

articles.headline: Stocks Are Defying Surging Bond Yields. Here's What History Says Could Come Next.
articles.body: Equities have ground higher even as long-term Treasury yields hit 24-year highs, a divergence that history suggests often resolves sharply. Analysts weigh whether the AI trade can keep powering the market.

articles.headline: U.K. Arrests Five in Suspected Terrorist Plot Near Air Base Used by U.S.
articles.body: British police arrested five people in connection with a suspected terrorist plot near an air base used by U.S. forces, officials said, in the latest security alert across Europe.

articles.headline: How to Know When the AI Boom Is About to Go Bust
articles.body: As AI valuations soar, investors are hunting for early signs of a top. Analysts point to capex sustainability, chip demand and corporate adoption rates as the telltale indicators.

articles.headline: Trump and Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei Set for White House Dinner
articles.body: President Trump is set to host Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei for a White House dinner, part of an ongoing dialogue with AI leaders over safety and regulation.

articles.headline: G7 to Release Up to 100 Million Barrels of Oil and Diesel
articles.body: The Group of Seven agreed to release as much as 100 million barrels of emergency oil and diesel over four months, coordinated by the IEA, to bring down soaring energy prices with an initial focus on diesel.

articles.headline: Nvidia Hits First Record Since May as Value Nears $6 Trillion
articles.body: Nvidia shares reached their first record since May as the AI chipmaker's market value approaches $6 trillion, with CEO Jensen Huang dismissing bubble fears and predicting another sales surge.

articles.headline: Nike Plans More Job Cuts to Boost Sputtering Turnaround
articles.body: Nike is planning further job cuts after first-quarter revenue fell 4% to $11.2 billion, missing estimates. The company expects to save $2.5 billion over five years as it restructures global operations.

articles.headline: OpenAI Restructuring Gives Microsoft a 27% Stake Worth $135 Billion
articles.body: OpenAI unveiled a sweeping restructuring that gives longtime backer Microsoft a 27% stake valued at about $135 billion, highlighting the unprecedented capital flooding the AI sector.

articles.headline: AMD to Buy Fei-Fei Li's World Labs AI Startup for $8.2 Billion
articles.body: AMD agreed to acquire World Labs, the AI startup co-founded by Fei-Fei Li, for $8.2 billion, deepening its push into spatial intelligence as it challenges Nvidia.

articles.headline: Cash-Strapped Americans Tap Home Equity and AI to Keep Spending
articles.body: With prices rising faster than wages for five straight months, U.S. consumers are drawing on home equity and AI tools to keep spending, even as consumption grows at the fastest pace in over a year.

articles.headline: U.S.-Russia Talks on Ukraine Involve Multi-Billion-Dollar Oil Deal
articles.body: The Trump administration's talks with Russia on ending the war in Ukraine have expanded to include a multibillion-dollar deal involving Lukoil's oil fields, refineries and gas stations, the Times reported.

articles.headline: Hiring Slows Sharply in September, Cooling Rate-Hike Fears
articles.body: U.S. employers added just 29,000 jobs in September and unemployment rose to 4.2%, reinforcing bets that the Federal Reserve will hold interest rates steady rather than raise them.

articles.headline: Trump Announces $200 Billion in Korean Investment in U.S. Energy
articles.body: President Trump announced a $200 billion Korean investment package spanning eight nuclear reactors, an Alaska LNG project and a Texas gas plant, part of a broader trade deal.

articles.headline: Nvidia's Jensen Huang Dismisses AI Bubble Fears
articles.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said he does not believe the industry is in an AI bubble, predicting its latest chips will generate half a trillion dollars in revenue as the company nears a $6 trillion valuation.

articles.headline: G7 Agrees to Release 100 Million Barrels of Oil and Diesel
articles.body: The Group of Seven agreed to release up to 100 million barrels of oil and diesel over four months to curb surging fuel prices, with an initial focus on diesel supplies.

articles.headline: Bond Yields Defy Falling Oil, Hitting Highest Levels in Decades
articles.body: Treasury yields kept climbing even as oil prices eased, with the 10-year briefly topping 5.34%, a divergence that analysts say signals entrenched inflation expectations.

articles.headline: Elon Musk to Return His Attention to Government, Advise Pentagon on Future of War
articles.body: Elon Musk is set to refocus on government work and advise the Pentagon on the future of warfare, deepening his role in U.S. defense policy.

articles.headline: Independent Researchers Reveal New Details About Rogue AI Agents
articles.body: Researchers are uncovering new details about rogue AI agents that may have breached more than 100 organizations, deepening concerns over the safety of autonomous systems.

articles.headline: Trump Says Secret Service Wants Him to 'Take Down' Oval Office
articles.body: President Trump claimed the Secret Service wants him to remove the Oval Office, drawing scrutiny amid ongoing security debates.

articles.headline: D.C., Amazon Settle Lawsuit Over Deliveries to Majority-Black Neighborhoods
articles.body: The District of Columbia and Amazon settled a lawsuit alleging the company delivered packages more slowly to majority-Black neighborhoods than to wealthier ones.

articles.headline: Americans Feel Worse About the Economy Than During the Pandemic
articles.body: A new survey finds Americans feel worse about the economy than at the depths of the pandemic, with inflation and high borrowing costs eroding confidence ahead of the midterms.

articles.headline: North Korea Launches Another Ballistic Missile
articles.body: North Korea conducted another ballistic missile launch toward waters east of the Korean Peninsula, according to South Korean and Japanese authorities, adding to regional tensions.

articles.headline: Amazon Seeks to Offload $8bn of Nvidia Chips to Investors
articles.body: Amazon is seeking to offload $8 billion of Nvidia chips to investors, a sign of shifting dynamics in the AI infrastructure market as cloud giants manage their capital commitments.

articles.headline: US Government Debt Rout Triggers 'Vicious Loop' of Selling
articles.body: A self-reinforcing sell-off gripped the US government bond market as long-term yields climbed to multi-decade highs, defying falling oil prices.

articles.headline: US Mortgage Rates Jump the Most in Four Years in Blow to Housing
articles.body: US mortgage rates posted their biggest jump in four years, hitting homebuilders and buyers as midterm elections approach.

articles.headline: G7 to Release 100 Million Barrels of Oil and Diesel
articles.body: The G7 agreed to release up to 100 million barrels of oil and diesel over four months, with a frontloaded diesel component, to ease record fuel prices.

articles.headline: Eurozone Borrowing Costs Surge in Global Bond Rout
articles.body: European debt suffered a bout of selling after US 10-year borrowing costs struck their highest level since 2002, lifting yields across the eurozone.

articles.headline: US Deploys Thousands of Troops to Middle East as Trump Weighs Strikes on Iran
articles.body: The US is deploying thousands of troops to the Middle East as President Trump weighs strikes on Iran, escalating regional tensions seven months into the conflict.
